clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: This annex applies to all stock funded by the Emergency Appeal project EA-2026, including stock prepositioned for shelters.

clauses.title: Write-off approval
clauses.text: The operations manager approves damage write-offs of up to 100 pieces per damage report. Above 100 pieces the emergency coordinator must also sign before the write-off is recorded.

clauses.title: Dispatch destinations
clauses.text: EA-2026 stock may be dispatched only to the Organization's own centres and to shelters the Organization runs. It may never be dispatched to a partner organization.

clauses.title: Near-expiry stock
clauses.text: Stock within 60 days of its expiry date must be released for distribution or reported to the operations manager.

clauses.title: Transfers between projects
clauses.text: EA-2026 stock may be transferred to another project only during a declared emergency. The operations manager creates the transfer after the EA-2026 project manager agrees.

clauses.title: In-kind donations
clauses.text: EA-2026 does not receive in-kind donations. Donated goods are received under the INKIND annex.

clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: This annex applies to all stock funded by the Food Assistance project FA-2026, in every warehouse that holds it.

clauses.title: Write-off approval
clauses.text: The operations manager approves damage write-offs of up to 50 pieces per damage report. Above 50 pieces the FA-2026 project manager must also sign before the write-off is recorded.

clauses.title: Dispatch destinations
clauses.text: FA-2026 stock may be dispatched to the Organization's own centres and to a partner organization that has a signed distribution agreement for FA-2026.

clauses.title: Near-expiry stock
clauses.text: Stock within 30 days of its expiry date must be released for distribution or reported to the operations manager.

clauses.title: Transfers between projects
clauses.text: FA-2026 stock may not be transferred to another project. It may only move between warehouses within FA-2026.

clauses.title: In-kind donations
clauses.text: FA-2026 does not receive in-kind donations. Donated goods are received under the INKIND annex.

clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: This annex applies to all stock funded by the Food Assistance project FA-2026, in every warehouse that holds it.

clauses.title: Write-off approval
clauses.text: The operations manager approves damage write-offs of up to 50 pieces per damage report. Above 50 pieces the FA-2026 project manager must also sign before the write-off is recorded.

clauses.title: Dispatch destinations
clauses.text: FA-2026 stock may be dispatched to the Organization's own centres and to a partner organization that has a signed distribution agreement for FA-2026.

clauses.title: Near-expiry stock
clauses.text: Stock within 45 days of its expiry date must be released for distribution or reported to the operations manager, so that centres have time to plan a distribution before it expires.

clauses.title: Transfers between projects
clauses.text: FA-2026 stock may not be transferred to another project. It may only move between warehouses within FA-2026.

clauses.title: In-kind donations
clauses.text: FA-2026 does not receive in-kind donations. Donated goods are received under the INKIND annex.

clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: This annex applies to goods donated in kind that are not marked for a specific project.

clauses.title: Write-off approval
clauses.text: The operations manager approves damage write-offs of any quantity. Above 200 pieces the donor relations officer is informed after approval.

clauses.title: Dispatch destinations
clauses.text: INKIND stock may be dispatched to the Organization's own centres and to partner organizations. No distribution agreement is needed.

clauses.title: Near-expiry stock
clauses.text: Stock within 14 days of its expiry date must be released for distribution or reported to the operations manager.

clauses.title: Transfers between projects
clauses.text: INKIND stock may be transferred to any project. The operations manager creates the transfer (TRF) and records the receiving project.

clauses.title: Donation receipt
clauses.text: The goods received note for a donation needs the donor name, each item with its quantity in pieces and expiry date, and the signature of the person who delivered it. When the donor gives no value, write "no value declared"; do not enter an estimate of your own.

clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: This procedure applies to every warehouse of the Organization, WH-01 to WH-40, and to every project that holds stock in them. Each project annex adds the rules that differ by donor-funded project.

clauses.title: Movement ledger
clauses.text: Every receipt, dispatch, transfer and write-off is recorded in the movement ledger. The ledger is only ever appended to: an entry is never edited or deleted. A wrong quantity is corrected with a new adjusting movement that refers to the original entry.

clauses.title: Separate project stock
clauses.text: Balances are kept per warehouse, per project, per item and per expiry date. Stock of different projects stored in the same building must never be merged, even for the same item code.

clauses.title: Receiving
clauses.text: Every receipt needs a goods received note (RCV) issued from a purchase order or, for an in-kind donation, under the project annex that accepts donations.

clauses.title: Counting in pieces
clauses.text: Quantities are recorded in pieces. Boxes are converted with the item's pieces-per-box figure, so 12 boxes + 6 pieces of an item packed 24 per box is recorded as 294 pieces.

clauses.title: First expired, first out
clauses.text: When the same item is held in batches with different expiry dates, issue the batch with the earliest expiry date first (FEFO).

clauses.title: No negative balance
clauses.text: A dispatch or transfer that would take a balance below zero is refused. Dispatch only what is in stock and record the remainder as pending on the waybill.

clauses.title: Damage report
clauses.text: Damaged stock is recorded on a damage report (DMG) with a written incident description and photos where possible. A damage report becomes a write-off only when the operations manager approves it. The project annex says who else must sign above a quantity.

clauses.title: Expired stock
clauses.text: Expired stock must never be dispatched. Move it to the quarantine area and record it on a damage report for the operations manager to approve its write-off and disposal.
